About — Tech Zone PK

Tech Zone PK Pakistan ka apna tech page hai — yahan aap ko milti hain naye smartphones ki khabrein, AI ki duniya, gadgets ke reviews, mobile tips & tricks aur tech buying guides — sab kuch asaan Urdu mein! Samsung, iPhone, OnePlus, Xiaomi, Google Pixel — jo bhi naya ho, sab se pehle yahan! Tech seekhna hai? To follow karein Tech Zone PK!

Facebook Page par har khabar ka sirf chhota sa teaser aur chhoti posts aati hain. Poora article padhne ke liye teaser ke link par tap karein — wo aap ko seedha yahan, usi article par le aayega.

  2. Shaam 18:00 — Tips / Guide post (teaser Page par, full guide yahan)
